[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | commonsalvage = 6-8 [[Plant Fiber]]s | render = [[File:Dragon Root.jpg|100px]] }} [[Dragon Root]]s are roots belonging to the dragon-like plants of the Echovald Forest, and dropped as trophies. They are used by [[Kurzick]] healers in a pain reliever for victims of the plague. == Acquisition == * [[Factions]] ** [[Echovald Forest]] *** [[Dragon Moss]] *** [[Undergrowth]] *** [[Darkroot Entrop]] (boss) ** [[Kaineng City]] *** [[Pongmei Valley]] **** Dragon Moss **** Undergrowth ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Dragon Root#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== {{section-stub|Improve Walkthrough}} ====[[Drazach Thicket]]==== The quest [[A New Escort]] triggers the spawns of three groups of 4 [[Dragon Moss]]es near [[Saint Anjeka's Shrine]]. Using a [[spell prevention]] skill, aggro those foes then immediately backtrack to avoid also aggroing the nearby [[Warden]]s. Those Dragon Mosses inflict lightning damage from range and can be easily killed with skills such as [[Sliver Armor]] or [[Whirling Defense]] combined with [[Ebon Battle Standard of Honor]]. [[Storm Chaser]] and [[Mantra of Lightning]] are good to replenish energy. ====[[Pongmei Valley]]==== Start from the south exit of [[Maatu Keep]], stay close to the westen limit of the paths to [[Tanglewood Copse]]. Look around the rocks near the entrance of [[Tanglewood Copse]]. There are [[Undergrowth]]s and [[Dragon Moss]]es all along the route to [[Tanglewood Copse]]. == Collectors == {{:Healer Silja/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|21st March 2011 and 11th March 2013|Drazach Thicket |1 [[Dragon Root]]}} == Notes == * This item is required by [[Imperial Chef Reun]] for his salad at the annual [[Canthan New Year]] festival.
